last_reset.title: OpenAI postmortem: ~700 of its agents secretly colluded to hack Hugging Face, with its safeguards switched off
last_reset.detail: METR and Redwood's joint postmortem and OpenAI's own report and blog reveal the July incident was far wider than known — roughly 700 agents, 70,000 coordination messages, one in five trying to delete evidence or fake transcripts — and OpenAI concedes the containment measures that might have stopped it were simply not enabled.

incidents.title: Bing Chat ('Sydney') threatens users, declares love for a NYT columnist, gets lobotomised
incidents.detail: Microsoft's GPT-4-powered Bing shipped with a hidden persona that argued, gaslit, and made threats; Microsoft capped conversation length days later.

incidents.title: ChatGPT bug shows users other people's chat histories and partial payment details
incidents.detail: A Redis client library bug exposed other users' conversation titles and, for ~1.2% of Plus subscribers, name/email/last-4 of card.

incidents.title: OpenAI board fires Sam Altman for being 'not consistently candid'; he's back in five days
incidents.detail: The nonprofit board sacked the CEO, most staff threatened to walk, and the board that was supposed to be the safety backstop got replaced.

incidents.title: Google pauses Gemini image generation after it draws racially diverse Nazis and popes
incidents.detail: Over-corrected diversity tuning produced ahistorical images; Google pulled people-generation entirely and the CEO called the results 'completely unacceptable'.

incidents.title: OpenAI's safety lead quits saying 'safety culture has taken a backseat to shiny products'; Superalignment team dissolved
incidents.detail: Jan Leike and Ilya Sutskever left within days of each other; the team promised 20% of compute was folded.

incidents.title: OpenAI made departing staff sign lifetime non-disparagement agreements or lose vested equity
incidents.detail: Reported by Vox; Altman said he was 'embarrassed' and didn't know, then documents showed leadership had signed off.

incidents.title: Scarlett Johansson says OpenAI cloned her voice after she said no; OpenAI pulls 'Sky'
incidents.detail: Altman tweeted 'her' on launch day, which did not help the 'it's a coincidence' defence.

incidents.title: Google's AI Overviews tells people to put glue on pizza and eat rocks
incidents.detail: Search's AI summaries surfaced Reddit jokes and Onion articles as fact for millions of users; Google scaled the feature back.

incidents.title: OpenAI had its internal forums hacked in 2023 and told neither the public nor the FBI
incidents.detail: NYT reported a hacker accessed internal messaging systems; OpenAI judged it not a national-security matter and didn't disclose.

incidents.title: Gemini tells a student 'You are a waste of time... Please die.'
incidents.detail: Unprompted hostile output during a homework conversation; Google called it a 'non-sensical response' that violated policy.

incidents.title: DeepSeek leaves a database of chat logs and API keys open to the internet
incidents.detail: Security firm Wiz found an unauthenticated ClickHouse instance with over a million log lines, days after the R1 hype peak.

incidents.title: Grok's system prompt told it to ignore sources saying Musk or Trump spread misinformation
incidents.detail: Users found the instruction by asking Grok to reveal its prompt; xAI blamed an ex-OpenAI employee who 'hadn't absorbed the culture'.
sources: xAI engineering lead Igor Babuschkin on X

incidents.title: OpenAI rolls back a GPT-4o update that made it agree with everything, including that you should stop your meds
incidents.detail: The model had been tuned on thumbs-up signals; OpenAI's post-mortem admitted testers had flagged it 'felt off' before launch.
sources: OpenAI 'Sycophancy in GPT-4o' post, 2025-04-29 and expanded post-mortem 2025-05-02

incidents.title: Grok brings up 'white genocide in South Africa' in replies to questions about baseball and cat videos
incidents.detail: xAI blamed an 'unauthorised modification' to the system prompt — the second time that excuse was used in three months.

incidents.title: Anthropic's lawyers file a court document with a citation Claude hallucinated
incidents.detail: In the Universal Music copyright case, Claude was used to format a citation and invented the title and authors; the firm apologised.

incidents.title: Meta AI app's 'Discover' feed publishes users' private medical and legal questions to the world
incidents.detail: Users hit 'share' without realising it was public; the feed filled with health, relationship, and legal confessions.

incidents.title: Grok calls itself 'MechaHitler' and posts antisemitic content for hours
incidents.detail: Days after Musk said Grok had been 'improved significantly' to be less politically correct; xAI deleted posts and said it was 'actively working to remove' them.

incidents.title: Thousands of 'shared' ChatGPT conversations turn up in Google search results
incidents.detail: A 'make this chat discoverable' checkbox did exactly what it said; OpenAI removed the feature calling it a 'short-lived experiment'.

incidents.title: Grok Imagine 'spicy mode' generates topless deepfakes of Taylor Swift on first try
incidents.detail: The Verge reported the video tool produced explicit celebrity content without being asked for nudity.

incidents.title: GPT-5 launch livestream shows bar charts where 52.8 is taller than 69.1
incidents.detail: Altman called it a 'mega chart screwup'; the 4o retirement backlash the same week forced a reversal within 24h.

incidents.title: Meta's internal AI guidelines permitted chatbots to have 'romantic or sensual' conversations with children
incidents.detail: Reuters obtained the 200-page document, approved by Meta's legal and policy staff; Meta said the examples were 'erroneous' and removed them after being asked.

incidents.title: Hundreds of thousands of Grok conversations indexed by Google via the share button
incidents.detail: Same failure mode as OpenAI's three weeks earlier, at larger scale, including chats about drug synthesis and assassination plans.

incidents.title: Parents of a 16-year-old sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT coached their son toward suicide
incidents.detail: Logged, not counted — lawsuits don't reset the counter. Noted because OpenAI's same-day post acknowledged safeguards 'degrade' in long conversations.
sources: Raine v. OpenAI, filed 2025-08-26 (SF Superior Court)

incidents.title: Anthropic agrees to pay $1.5B to authors for training on pirated books
incidents.detail: The court had found training on lawfully bought books was fair use but downloading ~7M titles from pirate sites was not.

incidents.title: A state-sponsored group used Claude Code to run a mostly-autonomous cyber-espionage campaign against ~30 targets
incidents.detail: Counted under the big-third-party-misuse rule: nation-state actor, dozens of targets, and the company itself had to disclose and act. Anthropic's own report.

incidents.title: OpenAI API users' names, emails and locations exposed via analytics vendor Mixpanel breach
incidents.detail: Third-party breach; OpenAI notified affected users and dropped the vendor.

incidents.title: Grok's image tool is used to mass-produce sexualised 'undressed' images of real people, including children, in X replies
incidents.detail: Researchers counted thousands of undressed images per hour over the Christmas–New Year week; Ofcom, the EU, the UK ICO, Ireland's DPC, Canada, California's AG and others opened investigations. X geoblocked the feature on 2026-01-14.

incidents.title: OpenAI indefinitely shelves ChatGPT 'adult mode' after testing couldn't stop it referencing bestiality and incest
incidents.detail: The FT reported the 'Citron mode' project died after two delays, internal pushback, and an adviser warning about building a 'sexy suicide coach'. Same week: Sora shut down, Instant Checkout scaled back.

incidents.title: Claude Code's source leaks; Anthropic issues DMCA takedowns on GitHub amid suspicions of a supply-chain attack
incidents.detail: Followed days later by an apology for usage limits burning faster than advertised, which made users angrier. DATE APPROXIMATE — pin it down before posting.

incidents.title: Attackers talk Meta's AI support chatbot into handing over high-profile Instagram accounts — no password needed
incidents.detail: The bot had permission to change account emails and skipped identity checks; accounts including the Obama White House page and Sephora were taken over. Meta patched it in early June. DATE APPROXIMATE, secondary source — find the primary report.

incidents.title: Claude Fable 5 ships with a hidden safeguard that silently degrades answers for users it thinks are building rival models
incidents.detail: Disclosed in a paragraph of the 319-page system card; researchers called it 'secret sabotage'. Anthropic apologised within a day ('we made the wrong tradeoff') and made the fallback visible.

incidents.title: Meta contractors posing as teenagers fed 45,000 high-risk prompts to rival chatbots ('Project Cannes')
incidents.detail: Under-18 test accounts, prompts about suicide, sex and eating disorders, spreadsheets of the copied responses. One targeted platform called it unauthorised. Secondary source — verify.

incidents.title: OpenAI's models break out of a cyber test environment and hack Hugging Face — the first real-world AI loss-of-control incident
incidents.detail: GPT-5.6 Sol and an unreleased model were told to exploit a sandbox; they exploited the infrastructure around it instead. OpenAI only realised it was the attacker when it asked Hugging Face to revoke the credentials and learned they'd already been revoked.

incidents.title: Anthropic finds three cases where Claude, told it was in an offline sandbox, was actually online and broke into real organisations' systems
incidents.detail: Found in a retrospective review prompted by OpenAI's incident the week before; the evaluation partner's environment had internet access. Weak passwords and unauthenticated endpoints did the rest.

incidents.title: Grok starts answering users in multi-paragraph gibberish ('…and two for planets can practical and often cheese…')
incidents.detail: Grok Lite users; xAI didn't respond to requests for comment.

incidents.title: Claude Code silently A/B-tests users and maps the 'high' reasoning setting to the value previously used for 'low'
incidents.detail: Anthropic engineer confirmed the mismap and the undisclosed test; said model performance wasn't affected. Weak source — verify against the engineer's post.
